title: Network initiated detach procedure completion by the network

entities.name: Timer T3422
entities.description: Timer used in network initiated detach procedure.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to accept detach procedure.

entities.name: Detach type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating type of detach procedure.

entities.name: EMM cause value
entities.description: Information element providing cause for EMM procedure.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is deregistered from network.

entities.name: IMSI detach condition
entities.description: Condition where Detach type IE indicates IMSI detach.

entities.name: Re-attach not required condition
entities.description: Condition where Detach type IE indicates re-attach not required.

entities.name: IMSI unknown condition
entities.description: Condition where EMM cause value is #2 IMSI unknown in HSS.

entities.name: No state change
entities.description: Network does not change current EMM state.

relations.description: Receipt of DETACH ACCEPT message stops timer T3422.
Detach type IE guards by IMSI detach condition.
Detach type IE guards by re-attach not required condition.
EMM cause value guards by IMSI unknown condition.
IMSI detach condition establishes no state change property.
Re-attach not required condition guards by IMSI unknown condition.
IMSI unknown condition establishes no state change property.
Otherwise condition establishes transition to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
